0022600207.text: The Dallas Mavericks, 6-4 and winners of their last two games, host the Indiana Pacers, who are 3-7 and coming off a loss, in the Mavericks' 11th game of the season. Dallas is 4-2 at home and sits 2 games back in the Southwest, while Indiana is 0-5 at home and 3.5 games back in the Central. Dallas will be without Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Morez Johnson Jr. (leg), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), while Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery) and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), and T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain) is day-to-day and a game-time decision.
